page_title: OSA 1-2 BET | Osasuna v Betis 19/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+12' The match has just finished.
90+9' Iker Losada (Betis) commits a rough challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick to Osasuna.
90+8' A yellow card for a tackle by Moi Gomez (Osasuna). Alejandro Ruiz doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
90+6' Here is a change. Pablo Fornals is going off and Manuel Pellegrini gives the last tactical orders to Ricardo Rodriguez (Betis).
90+6' The ref signals that VAR has overturned that yellow card and upgraded it to a straight red for Natan (Betis). He’s got to go!

90+5' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Natan (Betis), but referee Alejandro Ruiz must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
90+5' Natan (Betis) takes out his opponent with a nasty challenge and is relieved when the referee only gives him a booking.

90+4' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly over the crossbar.
90+3' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

90+2' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball is out of play and Osasuna manage to earn a corner.
90' There will be a minimum of 9 min. of added time.

90' Chimy Avila (Betis) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Sergio Herrera inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball low into the middle of the target, but was denied by a great save.
88' Substitution. Natan (Betis) on for Marc Bartra.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) will replace Bryan Zaragoza.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Moi Gomez is coming onto the pitch as Lucas Torro (Osasuna) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
87' The substitution is prepared. Ruben Pena (Osasuna) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Aimar Oroz.
87' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
84' A short pass finds Raul Garcia (Osasuna). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
80' Alejandro Ruiz shows a yellow card to Pablo Fornals (Betis) for a tough tackle.
79' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
77' Mateo Flores (Betis) makes a rough challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul. Osasuna will take a free kick near the side line.
77' Today's match ends for Pablo Ibanez who will be replaced by Raul Garcia (Osasuna).
75' The attendance is 21045.
74' Marc Bartra (Betis) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the middle of the goal, but Sergio Herrera is prepared to thwart his effort.
73' 1 - 2 Goal! Chimy Avila (Betis) fires the rebound into the top right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:2.
72' Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Alejandro Ruiz didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
70' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) has a great chance to score from deep inside the box! He finds some space for the shot, but sends it errantly way past the right post. Very bad attempt.
68' Substitution. Aitor Ruibal makes way for Mateo Flores (Betis).
68' Manuel Pellegrini decides to make a substitution. Sergi Altimira will be replaced by Iker Losada (Betis).
68' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
67' Substitution. Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) replaces Ruben Garcia.
67' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. Some classy goalkeeping by Rui Silva stops the ball out of the bottom right corner.
65' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Betis.
63' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
62' Flag up against Chimy Avila (Betis). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
60' Substitution. Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) has come on for Cedric Bakambu.
59' 1 - 1 Goal! Lucas Torro (Osasuna) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the right side of the goal. It's 1:1.
56' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
56' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
53' Chimy Avila (Betis) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.

50' Cedric Bakambu (Betis) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. It's a free kick to Osasuna, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
46' Manuel Pellegrini is forced to make a change. Vitor Roque (Betis) is unable to continue due to injury, Chimy Avila comes on.
46' Referee Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' The game is interrupted as Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) is flagged offside.
45+2' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) bravely wins the ball from the corner but can't direct it on target, sending it well wide of the left post from near the penalty spot.
44' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
43' The linesman signals that Ante Budimir (Osasuna) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.

43' What a chance that is! Ante Budimir (Osasuna) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He and produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes well wide of the left post!
42' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) will take a corner kick.
41' Wow, what an escape. Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. Osasuna will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
40' Pablo Fornals (Betis) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
39' Referee Alejandro Ruiz sees the trip by Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Betis earn a free kick.
37' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
35' Vitor Roque (Betis) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
33' Vitor Roque (Betis) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
32' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
32' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) takes a short corner kick.
31' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out of play. Osasuna are awarded a corner kick.
30' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
28' The linesman raises his flag. Cedric Bakambu (Betis) is adjudged offside.
27' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Pablo Fornals (Betis).

26' Hector Bellerin (Betis) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Sergio Herrera has it covered and makes a comfortable save. The ball goes out for a corner. Betis can continue in their attacking effort.
25' Pablo Fornals (Betis) has a great chance inside the box following a rebound off a defender, but somehow he gets underneath the ball and it flies high over the bar.
25' What a great touch by Vitor Roque (Betis) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.

23' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Rui Silva pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
22' Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul after Jesus Areso (Osasuna) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Betis have been awarded a free kick.
20' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Ruben Garcia (Osasuna). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
19' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
17' A clever short pass gives Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar.
16' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle. Betis win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.

15' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) found himself in a promising position. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper was ready and made a decent save.
14' Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul. Betis have a free kick.
13' Diego Llorente (Betis) outjumps his marker and heads the resulting corner way wide of the left post.
13' Pablo Fornals (Betis) takes the corner.

11' Vitor Roque (Betis) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. The ball goes behind for a corner. Betis will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
7' 0 - 1 Vitor Roque (Betis) receives a well-taken defence-splitting pass inside the box and scores! He buries the ball into the bottom left corner.
6' Hector Bellerin (Betis) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
4' Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Betis will kick the game off.
Alejandro Ruiz will officiate today.
